_fixtureNote: Per-cell LIDs on the GridData path (Task 41). ROW-MAJOR over the whole 3x2 lattice, one slot per cell whatever form `bins` takes. null marks an unnamed cell; the EMPTY STRING at index 1 is a real LID of zero length (E142 types LID as xs:string with no minLength) and is deliberately NOT the same as null. The values are awkward on purpose - leading/trailing space, mixed case, a separator, a numeric-looking one - because a LID is a join key and is never trimmed or case-folded.
